race.verdict: Stall 11 could have been better but PHOENIX OF DREAMS is at the top of his game on all-weather at present so he may well overcome it under a penalty. Billy Mill is a reliable proposition at this venue, with Split Elevens completing the shortlist. PHOENIX OF DREAMS (IRE) BILLY MILL SPLIT ELEVENS
